title: Sales And Marketing Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities Identify and acquire new B2B clients for FTL transportation services. Generate leads through cold calling, field visits, networking, and market research. Develop business across Steel, Cement, Coal, FMCG, Pharma, Minerals, and Manufacturing sectors. Achieve sales targets and drive revenue growth. Prepare quotations, proposals, and participate in auctions and bidding. Negotiate freight rates, commercial terms, and long-term contracts. Manage key accounts and maintain strong client relationships. Coordinate with Operations, Fleet, and Accounts teams. Maintain sales pipelines and MIS reports. Preferred candidate profile 8+ years of experience in Logistics / Transportation Sales. Strong experience in FTL (Full Truck Load) logistics sales and B2B client acquisition. Experience in acquiring corporate clients and managing key accounts. Good knowledge of freight rates, vehicle types, routes, and transportation operations. Experience in commercial negotiations, tenders, and bidding. Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills. Willingness to travel for client meetings and business development. Education: Any Bachelor's Degree; MBA in Marketing / Sales preferred. Contact :9655127399, 9655127199

Key Skills: Sales And Marketing,Business development,Trucks,Transportation,Sales,Load,Client acquisition,Marketing
